question: Regarding the expression of the IL-2 receptor:

options.opa: Resting T lymphocytes express the high affinity form.
options.opb: Resting T lymphocytes express alpha chain.
options.opc: Resting T lymphocytes express the complex of bera and gamma chains common in high quantity.
options.opd: Activated T lymphocytes express the common alpha, beta and gamma chains.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Resting T lymphocytes -> express IL-2 receptor -> with high affinity form -> 80% CHAIN: Resting T lymphocytes -> express IL-2 receptor -> alpha chain -> 70% CHAIN: Resting T lymphocytes -> express IL-2 receptor -> complex of beta and gamma chains -> common in high quantity -> 75% CHAIN: Activated T lymphocytes -> express IL-2 receptor -> common alpha, beta, and gamma chains -> 80%
analysis: Resting T lymphocytes do not express the high affinity form of the IL-2 receptor. The IL-2 receptor on resting T lymphocytes consists of the alpha chain only.
